note: Links from names on the Gaza list to memorial pages, added and checked by hand. Each one is for a page that the strict name-matching rules in ingest/sources/memorials.py cannot link, because the page itself does not give enough of the person's name. The basis says what the identification rests on, including anything that does not come from the page. `python -m ingest memorials` never writes to this file. The site marks these links as checked by hand.

living-record.name: The Living Record
living-record.by: Writers Against the War on Gaza

records: The page gives only the first name Reem, with photographs captioned 'soul of the soul'. It was identified by hand as the widely reported story of a girl of 3 whose grandfather, Khaled Nabhan, called her 'soul of my soul', and who was killed with her brother Tariq, aged 5. Reem Ali Khalil Badwan (3) and Tariq Ali Khalil Badwan (5) are the only sister and brother on the Ministry's list with those names and ages. No primary source for the story is cited yet.
